options.text: <path>/ai/ as a built-in path extension beside md/, fs/ and inbox/; a declared child named ai wins; ?drawer= and ?sheet= rewritten once
options.say: <path>/ai/ as a built-in path extension beside md/, fs/ and inbox/; a declared child named ai wins; ?drawer= and ?sheet= rewritten once

options.say: A reserved segment that never collides: <path>/~ai/
caveats: Not the owner's word (any path can have an ai/ subdirectory)

options.caveat: Not the owner's word (any path can have an ai/ subdirectory) Does not match where the data already is (<page>ai/chat.jsonl) Would win only if a page ever needs both a real ai child and the sheet routed

decision.why: It is the owner's own words; Page.child() already serves md/, fs/ and inbox/ on every page only when no declared child has that name, so 'a real ai child wins' is the existing rule; and Servex already saves each page's chat to <page>ai/chat.jsonl, so the route lands on the data's own folder
